annotation.speech2: Four rows. Each row shows the product one plus x written four times, with arrows pointing up at the one term picked out of each factor: an x from three of the factors, drawn as orange arrows, and the one from the remaining factor, drawn as a gray arrow. Every row multiplies out to x cubed, and the four rows are the only ways to do it, so the coefficient of x cubed is four.
The first way: the x is taken from the first, second and third factors, and the one from the fourth factor. Multiplying the four picks gives x times x times x times one, which is x cubed.
The second way: the x is taken from the first, second and fourth factors, and the one from the third factor. Multiplying the four picks gives x times x times one times x, which is x cubed.
The third way: the x is taken from the first, third and fourth factors, and the one from the second factor. Multiplying the four picks gives x times one times x times x, which is x cubed.
The fourth way: the x is taken from the second, third and fourth factors, and the one from the first factor. Multiplying the four picks gives one times x times x times x, which is x cubed.
